subject: GovSec comp band clearance: Senior Security Engineer & Compliance Lead
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: GovSec comp band clearance: Senior Security Engineer & Compliance Lead

Team —

Following our hiring sync, I'm sending the formal request to clear compensation bands and headcount for two GovSec hires we need to close by EOY:

- Senior Security Engineer (IC, infra-facing) — req GOVSEC-234
- Compliance Lead (managerial, audits & SOC2 ownership) — req GOVSEC-235

Attached: comp-band-matrix.xlsx (proposed bands by level), headcount-req-GovSec.docx (brief role descriptions + business justification).

Ask: please confirm approval to extend offers up to the band max for the Senior Security Engineer and up to midpoint+15% for the Compliance Lead. We have two strong candidates in process and a third inbound from Lincoln Partners (see attached shortlist coming tomorrow). Hiring timeline is tight — ideally offers signed by Dec 3 to start Jan 2027 orientation.

Notes:
- These roles are critical to our upcoming audit cadence and ramping the infra hardening project.
- Total incremental FY27 OPEX impact (on-run-rate) is estimated at $292k annualized if both hired at the top of band.

Please flag any counters or if Finance/Evelyn needs a separate justification packet.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, GovSec Recruiting
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: comp-band-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: headcount-req-GovSec.docx (doc)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GovSec comp band clearance: Senior Security Engineer & Compliance Lead

Marissa —

Thanks for the packet and the clear ask. Quick responses:

1) Senior Security Engineer: Approved to extend up to band max for a strong external hire, provided total comp (base+bonus) stays within the attached comp-band-matrix and the candidate clears the technical bar. Please include a short 1-paragraph justification in the offer memo explaining the business impact and how this hire shortens the audit remediation timeline.

2) Compliance Lead: I can approve up to midpoint + 10% as a standard leadership flexibility. For anything beyond midpoint+10% we need Evelyn sign-off given the budget delta. Please re-run the OPEX impact with the final proposed salary and send to Evelyn if you anticipate going above +10%.

3) If Lincoln Partners presents counteroffers above the band, route them to me and Evelyn before extending. Also copy Finance on any offers > midpoint+12%.

I'm in favor of accelerating these hires; prioritize the Senior Security Engineer first.

Rishi
VP, Platform Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: comp-band-matrix-revised.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Lincoln Partners <talent@lincoln-recruiting.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate shortlist for GOVSEC-234 / GOVSEC-235

Hi Marissa / Rishi —

Attached is the short list we discussed. Quick highlights:

- Candidate A (Senior Security Engineer): currently at $240k total comp, interested in Redwood for infrastructure scale and ownership. Expect counter request up to band max.
- Candidate B (Senior Security Engineer): $220k total comp, will accept near midpoint + 5%.
- Candidate C (Compliance Lead): Director-level at a fintech, current comp $280k total; expects close to midpoint + 12% to consider an org move.

We recommend moving Candidate A to an expedited loop; they have a competing offer with a final timeline 11/30. Candidate B is a strong fallback. Candidate C is viable if the Compliance Lead can be offered midpoint+12% (Evelyn flag noted).

Attachments: candidate-shortlist.pdf (resumes + comp summary). We can provide reference call notes within 24 hours on request.

Best,

C. Jensen
Managing Director, Lincoln Partners
[Attachment: candidate-shortlist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GovSec comp band clearance: Senior Security Engineer & Compliance Lead

Marissa —

Per Lincoln's note, given Candidate A's competing timeline I authorize the following final delegations:

- Senior Security Engineer (GOVSEC-234): Marissa may extend an offer up to band max immediately. Please include the 1-paragraph business justification in the offer memo and confirm final total comp to me and Finance within 24 hours of acceptance.

- Compliance Lead (GOVSEC-235): Mina may extend up to midpoint + 10% without further sign-off. If the team wants to exceed midpoint+10% (e.g., Candidate C at +12%), Evelyn please confirm whether you will approve the incremental spend; if not, we should continue the search.

Next steps for Marissa: issue an offer template via DocuSign for Candidate A with expected start date Jan 10, 2027. Copy Mina and me on the envelope. If Candidate A counter-offers above band max, pause and escalate to me immediately.

I'll mark this closed on my side once I see DocuSign completion. Thanks for moving fast — this team is a priority for the audit window.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Platform Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: offer-approval-summary.pdf (brief)]
